safeguards.label: Remote desktop hidden from the internet
safeguards.problem: remote desktop (RDP, port 3389) open to the whole internet
safeguards.ok_text: remote desktop is not visible from the internet
safeguards.evidence: The router forwards port 3389 to the owner's computer. The previous IT person set it up that way.
safeguards.fix: Remove the port 3389 forwarding on the router. Use a VPN to work from home.

safeguards.label: Every computer has a different admin password
safeguards.problem: an "admin" account with the same password on 3 computers
safeguards.ok_text: every computer has its own admin password
safeguards.evidence: The admin password is the same on the owner's, the front office's and accounting's computers.
safeguards.fix: Set different admin passwords (Windows LAPS does it automatically). Staff work on accounts without admin rights.

safeguards.label: System and programs up to date
safeguards.evidence: Automatic Windows updates are on for every workstation.

safeguards.label: Drives encrypted
safeguards.evidence: BitLocker is on for the laptops.

safeguards.label: Two-step login (MFA) in Microsoft 365
safeguards.problem: 2 of 8 accounts without two-step login, accounting among them
safeguards.evidence: Accounting's and the front office's accounts sign in with a password alone.
safeguards.fix: Turn on MFA (the Microsoft Authenticator app) for every account. Start with accounting.

safeguards.label: DMARC record (protection against spoofing)
safeguards.problem: domain without DMARC, anyone can send an email "from the office"
safeguards.fix: Add a _dmarc TXT record with p=quarantine, after 2 weeks p=reject.

safeguards.label: Account number changes are confirmed by phone
safeguards.problem: an email is enough to change an account number
safeguards.ok_text: account number changes are always confirmed by phone
safeguards.evidence: Accounting updates vendors' account numbers based on an email.
safeguards.fix: Set a rule: account number changes are confirmed by phone on the number from the contract. Print it and pin it by the accounting desk.

safeguards.label: A backup kept off the network
safeguards.problem: the backup drive is always connected and would be encrypted with everything else
safeguards.evidence: The NAS is mapped as drive Z: on every computer.
safeguards.fix: Once a week back up to a USB drive that goes back into the safe afterwards. Unmap the NAS from the computers.

safeguards.label: Backup restore tested
safeguards.problem: nobody has checked whether files can be restored from the backup
safeguards.evidence: Nobody knows when files were last restored from the backup.
safeguards.fix: Restore one folder from the backup and check that the files open.

safeguards.label: WordPress and plugins up to date
HTTPS and a valid certificate
safeguards.evidence: The certificate is valid for 61 more days.
safeguards.fix: Turn on HTTPS at the host.
